# @three-ws/sign-language

> American Sign Language for 3D avatars. Compile text into one continuous signed animation clip: known words sign from a lexicon of anatomically described signs, everything else fingerspells, with contact solving and non-manual facial markers. Zero runtime dependencies.

@three-ws/sign-language is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/sign-language`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/sign-language/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/sign-language/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/sign-language/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/sign-language/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
